name: youtube-declutter-dev
description: Dev-only tooling for the YouTube Declutter extension (tests + packaging). Never shipped in the extension.

scripts.package:zip: npm run package && cd dist && zip -X -o -r ../yt-declutter-$npm_package_version.zip . && cd .. && echo "wrote yt-declutter-$npm_package_version.zip (deterministic: zip -X -o)"
